                                                                                                  26-6-11

            RESOLUTION TO LEVY A TAX RATE IN MONTGOMERY COUNTY,
             TENNESSEE, FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2026

        SECTION 1. BE IT RESOLVED by the Board of County Commissioners of Montgomery
County, Tennessee, assembled in regular session on this 8th day of June, 2026, that the combined property
tax for Montgomery County, Tennessee, for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026 shall be $2.10 on each
$100 of taxable property within the County, which is to provide revenue for each of the following funds
and otherwise conform to the following levies:

                                                        FY 2025     FY 2026 FY 2027
                Funds                                    Rate        Rate    Rate
                County General                           $0.980       $1.080 $1.130
                General Roads                             0.150        0.140  0.140
                General Purpose School                    0.369        0.369  0.369
                Debt Service                              0.440        0.340  0.390
                General Purpose Capital Projects          0.130        0.140  0.040
                School Transportation                     0.031        0.031  0.031
                Total Tax Rate                           $2.100       $2.100 $2.100


        SECTION 2. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that total taxes due shall be rounded to the
nearest $1.00 for each tax bill. Amounts from $0.50 to $0.99 will be rounded up, pursuant to TCA § 67-
5-102.

       SECTION 3. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that all resolutions of the Board of County
Commissioners of Montgomery County, Tennessee, which are in conflict with this resolution are hereby
repealed.

         SECTION 4. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that this resolution shall take effect from and
after its passage, the public welfare requiring it. This resolution shall be spread upon the minutes of the
Board of County Commissioners.

       Duly passed and approved this 8th day of June 2026.

                                                  Sponsor _____________________________________


                                           Commissioner _____________________________________


                                                 Approved _____________________________________
                                                                       Wes Golden, County Mayor
